thread:
mira (support): Customer ACME-App reporting repeated 429s during morning traffic spike. They say it was a ~45s burst where latency was fine but tokens dropped quickly. Need guidance on burst credits + short-term smoothing.
mira (support): they pasted a snippet: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"..."}'
```
acme-sre: Confirmed. We saw ~700 concurrent requests over 30s, then back to normal. First 429 at 11:03:17, last at 11:04:05.
rate-limit-bot: ALERT: client_acme (proj-45) burst_bucket_exhausted (90% -> 100%) at 1769001380.
jonah (infra): Quick summary: our rate limiter is token-bucket based per-project + per-route. We allow a small burst buffer (burst credits) to absorb short spikes — then refill steady-state at configured cps (calls/sec) or tokens/sec depending on route.
jonah (infra): In practice: sustained rate > commit -> throttled. Short spikes within burst window get served until credits drain.
sophia (quota): For ACME-App looks like they exhausted their burst credits. Their commit is 200 rps, burst allowance 500 tokens over 60s. They did ~700 rps for 45s which drained the bucket. After that new requests returned 429 until bucket refilled.
mira (support): What can we offer them short-term? They want automatic smoothing or temporary allowance.
sophia (quota): Options:
- Temporary burst extension (manual override) for 1 hour.
- Increase committed capacity (Dedicated/reserve).
- Suggest client-side smoothing + exponential backoff retries.
- Configure per-route lower concurrency (streaming vs generate)
We can apply a +300 burst credit boost immediately if they accept.
kevin (eng): For client suggestions, recommend the standard retry pattern: randomized jitter + exponential backoff, max 6 retries. Example: 
```
# python pseudocode
for attempt in range(6):
  resp = do_request()
  if resp.status != 429:
    break
  sleep((2**attempt)*0.1 + random()*0.1)
```
kevin (eng): Also encourage smoothing on their side: queue at ingress, ramp to target over ~5-10s rather than floor-totally burst. Batching small requests if possible.
acme-sre: Any repro steps we should run to replicate? We want to show product team.
jonah (infra): Easiest repro: run a short spike script that sends 700 concurrent reqs for 45s and monitor 429s. Example loader (hey) command: 
```
hey -z 45s -c 700 -m POST -d '{"input":"x"}' -T 'application/json' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
jonah (infra): Alternatively use a single-worker async Python harness to create bursty fanout — we'll share a snippet in the ticket.
sophia (quota): Notes for ticket: include request ids (X-Request-Id), root project id, timestamps, samples of 429 responses (headers we set: x-rate-limit-remaining, x-rate-limit-reset, x-burst-remaining). Those headers help us verify.
mira (support): Customer sent one 429 body: `{\n  "error": { "type": "rate_limit", "message": "burst credits exhausted", "retry_after": 9 }\n}`
jonah (infra): That matches expected. If they need zero-drop during spikes, recommend Dedicated with higher committed rps or background caching + pre-warming.
sophia (quota): Another smoothing policy we have: adaptive smoothing can be enabled per-account: it spreads short spikes by queueing up to N requests for T ms, smoothing at gateway. It reduces 429 but increases tail latency. We can enable it temporarily — requires consent.
kevin (eng): For production guidance: instrument client to log latency and 429s, include `x-request-id` and timestamp on each call. If they want, we can run an offline analysis and provide suggested commit/burst numbers (we usually recommend commit >= 95th percentile steady rps and burst >= 2x short-duration peak).
acme-sre: Can you estimate refill time for their bucket?
sophia (quota): Rough math: bucket size 500 tokens, refill 200 tokens/min -> to fully refill ~2.5 minutes. So after big drain they will see 429s until refill crosses threshold.
mira (support): Action items:
- ACME to confirm if they want temporary +300 burst credits for 1 hour (sophia to apply)
- ACME to provide sample `X-Request-Id` values + full timestamps + a representative payload
- Jonah/kevin to share repro snippet + brief analysis of headers for last 24h
- Support to schedule follow-up in 2 hours
sophia (quota): I'll prep the override and post here once applied.
rate-limit-bot: OVERRIDE_APPLIED: proj-45 +300burst until 1769005490 (manual by sophia).
mira (support): Thanks team. ACME wants the repro snippet now, sending.
acme-sre: sending logs now, thank you. We'll validate after boost.
kevin (eng): If they still see bursts after boost, we'll look for request patterns (e.g., retry storms or client-side thundering herd). Common cause: parallel SDK retries without jitter.
mira (support): closing loop here once they confirm. :thumbsup:
